economic_hypothesis: When the same-board median stock falls at least 1.5% in a completed session, systematic sellers have a strong common opportunity to dominate prices. A stock that simultaneously rises at least 6%, exceeds its board by at least 8 points, closes above its prior-20 high on expanded turnover and near the daily high reveals an idiosyncratic demand shock strong enough to defeat that common supply.

causal_state.history: 20 preceding symbol rows exist and all are hard-valid/current-valid/tradable.
causal_state.systematic_supply: same-board cross-sectional median completed-session step return <=-1.5%.

trigger.idiosyncratic_return: stock completed-session step return >=+6% and stock minus same-board median >=8 percentage points.
trigger.price_discovery: coordinate close strictly above preceding-20 maximum coordinate high.
trigger.not_limit_up: coordinate close strictly below the legal upper-limit coordinate.
trigger.deduplication: qualifying events no more than 20 market-session indices apart form one symbol cluster; retain its first event.

decision_at: signal close after same-board cross-section is complete
profile_selection: 2014-2018 only: maximize median annual mean net return, then pooled mean, then shorter horizon.
confirmation: Only selected profile on 2019-2021; require average completed trades/year >50, pooled mean net >3%, pooled median >0, every confirmation-year mean >0.
